entities.summary: Francesco Dall'Olio is a retired Italian volleyball player. He was part of Italian teams that finished second at the 1978 World Championships and 1975 Mediterranean Games; third at the 1984, eighth at the 1976 and ninth at the 1980 Summer Olympics.
